segments.text: You enter a laboratory one morning, and the flutter tape is blowing out, indicating air
segments.zh: 一天早上你走进实验室，发现飘带向外飘，说明空气

segments.text: is moving out of the laboratory.
segments.zh: 正在从实验室向外流动。

segments.text: You know that directorial air flow should flow into the laboratory.
segments.zh: 你知道定向气流应该是流入实验室的。
